mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CLUBMEMBER (STUDENTID, CLUBNUM, REGDATE) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{clubNum}, SYSDATE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CLUBMEMBER WHERE STUDENTID = #{studentId} AND CLUBNUM = #{clubNum}
mapper.select: SELECT M.STUDENTID, C.CLUBNUM, H.REGDATE, M.NAME, M.MAJOR, M.EMAIL1, M.EMAIL2, M.PHONE, C.CLUBNAME FROM MEMBER M JOIN CLUBMEMBER H ON M.STUDENTID = H.STUDENTID JOIN CLUB C ON C.CLUBNUM = H.CLUBNUM WHERE H.CLUBNUM = #{clubNum} ORDER BY H.REGDATE DESC

SELECT M.STUDENTID, C.CLUBNUM, H.REGDATE, M.NAME, M.MAJOR, M.EMAIL1, M.EMAIL2, M.PHONE, C.CLUBNAME FROM MEMBER M JOIN CLUBMEMBER H ON M.STUDENTID = H.STUDENTID JOIN CLUB C ON C.CLUBNUM = H.CLUBNUM WHERE H.STUDENTID = #{studentId} ORDER BY H.REGDATE DESC
